text: Recipient not at home: leave with a neighbour only if the sender allows it, otherwise take the parcel to the nearest pickup point and send the recipient a notification card.
Second failed delivery attempt: hold at the pickup point for 7 days, then return to sender.
Address incomplete or unreadable: hold at the depot and contact the recipient by phone or email to confirm the address within 24 hours.
Recipient moved or unknown at address: return to depot and check for a forwarding address before returning to sender.
Held at customs because documents are missing: request the commercial invoice from the sender within 24 hours; urgency high.
Import duties unpaid: notify the recipient with a payment link; hold the parcel for up to 14 days.
Parcel visibly damaged: photograph the damage, do not deliver if contents are exposed, open a damage claim and inform the sender.
Recipient refused the parcel: record the reason and start the return-to-sender process.
Delay due to weather, traffic or vehicle breakdown: reschedule for the next delivery day and send the recipient an updated time window.
Parcel missed its connection at the hub: re-route on the next available line haul and flag it if the delivery promise is at risk.
